notes.title: Bake 'n Switch - PC Patch v1.0.4-8339
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
This patch adds the remaining single player maps (Stormy and Shroom) along with additional bug fixes and general game improvements

Gameplay Changes:

Allow the player to move when grabbing instead of coming to a stop
Doughs now conserve momentum when they merge allowing for 'chain-merging'
Reward system now supports clients receiving rewards when playing online
Added remaining Solo Stormy and Shroom maps
Added new Puzzle maps, with unique BGM


Bug fixes:

Fixed issues with Key Bindings not being applied or binding incorrectly
Fixed various issues when restarting a level
Fixed issues in a number of levels where the doughs can get stuck at certain locations
Tweaked collisions where the player or doughs could accidently fall through certain levels
Fixed a few localization issues where the wrong language would be shown for some UI elements
Many other fixes related to dough AI, Boss Fights, Audio, and Online Gameplay


Misc.

Added Kickstarter exclusive Candy Witch costume for Sage
 - Codes for the costume will be sent out by email in the coming weeks

notes.title: Bake 'n Switch - PC Patch v1.0.1-26218
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
This patch focuses on fixing various bugs and addressing issues with initial controller setup when playing local co-op (Offline)

Changes:

 Added support for Chinese (Simple and Traditional) languages
 Improved UI flow when playing Offline (local co-op) for controller selection


Bug fixes: 

 Fixed an issue where all inputs were not registered if controller was disconnected.  
 Fixed an issue where players remain stuck at “Sign in” message after disconnecting the internet at Main menu just before entering online. 
 Fixed an issue where the game does not accept any input if you boot the game offline. 
 Fixed a bug where loading screen persists for Host if the last client disconnects game during Level selection cutscene play. 
 UI fixes for Graphical settings and Language selection. 
 Fixed achievement “Baker Perfection” not unlocking with correct condition. 
 Fixed an issue where Ready Up screen goes missing for remaining players if one of the clients disconnects during the Level cutscene. 
 Multiple Achievements fixed which were not unlocking for Client 
 Multiple Progressive Achievements fixed whose progress was getting reset after launching specific levels. 
 Keybinding issues fixed where certain keys could not be bound. 
 Maurice Boss level issues fixed – Boss was disappearing when shadow setting was set to low. 
 Maurice Boss level issues fixed – Incorrect flavour order appears during level restart after 2nd phase of boss fight. 
 Beetle bob boss level issue fixed – Beetle bob was disappearing when shadow setting was set to low. 
 Key Binding message fixed when player tries to key bind using a controller. 
 Auto save feature fixed for certain option settings not getting saved when user returns back to main menu. 
 Several minor visual fixes and data table balancing in various levels.

notes.title: The Buns Are Running Amok in New ‘Bun Madness’ Trailer
notes.content:
Let's Talk Buns

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35387815/dcce85b094619a835b30ccc881685b90c5e97622.jpg


Tropic Toaster’s Lil’ Bun starts out as a roly-poly doughball and chomps its way into a Big Lil' Bun - give these little guys some space, and they’ll do your delicious work for you! The Doughdoughs may not be the smartest Buns in the batch, but while they scare easily, they are easy to herd. Surround them and watch them flock toward the oven and hop right in! While the Doughdoughs and Lil’ Buns may be easier to manage, the Doughrillas have music in their feet and pound their mighty hands to their own jungle beat!

In Serradurra, the sweet “dessert” world, you’ll encounter a whole new bunch of delectably devious Buns. Armadoughs are tough on the outside, but… actually, just tough all the way through! These curly croissants act as giant bowling balls to smash through flavors and barriers. The sneaky Bunboa burrows its body in the sand and launches surprise attacks to constrict your enemies. Fluff Foxes are fiendishly cute - fast, with a stunning tailspin. You’ll need to work as a team to corner these sly confections and corral them into the oven. And finally, Batlava, whose super sweet - and sharp - tooth sucks the flavor right off those Buns in no time flat!

notes.title: New World, New Bakers, New Buns, oh my!
notes.content:
3 New Buns, 2 New Bakers, 1 New World, Let's #getbaked!

We've been warming things up, but now we can officially show off the latest and greatest from the Bake 'n Switch team. On the menu today, the Serradurra desert world - complete with 50 co-op levels and three new adoughrable Buns; Armadough, Fluff Fox, and Bunboa join our starting lineup, and with unique behaviors like tailspins, battle armor, and venom strikes, we think they'll be a welcome addition to the party!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35387815/8534293ee083eff754a166bcc2f241ea509425f3.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35387815/50c22cc2343ab7500ebe55423d38fddc3c741ec9.jpg

To help them on their Bake 'n Switch quest, our herby Bakers have welcomed two new Apprentices to the mix. Introducing Sage and Salt! Sage whips up a witchy brew that sucks in Mouldies, and immediately bakes nearby Buns adding to your rising score. While Salt wields his crusty, grappling-hook to wrangle in runaway Doughs.
